arms.presentedMessage: Blocks are nested too deeply (4). Maximum allowed is 3.

Blocks are nested too deeply (4). Maximum allowed is 3. Why: Deeply nested control flow hides exit conditions and makes edge cases harder to reason about. How to fix: Use guard clauses or early returns, then extract nested branches into focused helpers. Before: `if (a) { if (b) { if (c) { if (d) run(); } } }`. After: `if (!a || !b || !c || !d) return; run();`.
